$comment: JARVIS JUNIOR — the children's build, packaged from this same repo.
extraMetadata stamps the edition into the packaged package.json, which is
what core/edition.js reads at startup. The renamed 'name' gives the junior
build its own %APPDATA% folder, so a child's settings, chart, and notes
never mix with the grown-up JARVIS on the same PC — and the grown-up
build's saved cloud API key is not inherited by the children's one.
Both installers can be present at once: different appId, different
product name, different icon, different shortcuts.
